p.b:
Install the browser extension
(Brave or Chrome)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OPTIONAL
run the save-login launcher.
CWL login can be stored encrypted
in Windows Credential Manager
or the macOS Keychain.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Shows the startup notes:
log folder, saved login,
keeping the computer awake,
how to stop

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p: Log in to Elentra as usual

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The extension will check
your login state

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sends the temporary Elentra
session cookie to the script

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Toolbar badge:
😎 = logged in
🫠 = awaiting login
💀 = not running

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Has the extension
sent a cookie?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Waiting for you
to log in. Checks again
when a cookie arrives.

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Opens the Elentra dashboard
with your cookie

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Logged in
Ping again in ~15 min

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Computer just woke up:
check right away

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check: is the CWL
login page is open?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Waits until you finish,
then back to routine ↻

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Have we exhausted any
previous login attempts?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
You must log in manually
in the browser. The script
will resume automatically.

div.style: color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Extension opens Elentra
in a background tab

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Are you already signed in?
(CWL session still valid)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(27, 31, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fills in and submits
the CWL login form
automatically

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Back in. Tab closes;
the routine carries on.

svg.text: How Elentra Keepalive keeps you logged in
